model_annotations.Bulgarian: This grouped vertical bar chart illustrates the Accuracy (%) of six different methods evaluated across three distinct categories. The horizontal axis displays the categories, ordered from left to right as "Mathverse", "MMLU", and "Physics", with the labels visually emphasized in bold text. The vertical axis represents the value, labeled "Accuracy (%)", utilizing a linear scale that ranges from 50 to 62 with tick marks at regular intervals of 2 units, accompanied by a dashed horizontal grid. Within each category, there is a cluster of six bars representing specific methods, identified by a legend at the top of the chart. From left to right within each group, the bars represent: DAPO (light blue with diagonal hatching), DAPO+Self-reflection (solid blue), GRPO (light orange with diagonal hatching), SRPO (solid orange), PPO (light green with diagonal hatching), and PPO+Self-reflection (solid dark green). All bars feature a solid black outline. The heights of the bars vary by category and method. In the "Mathverse" group, values range from approximately 53.1% for DAPO to about 56.1% for DAPO+Self-reflection. In the "MMLU" group, PPO records the lowest value at roughly 54.6%, while SRPO reaches the highest at approximately 57.1%. The "Physics" category displays the highest overall values, ranging from about 56.9% for PPO to approximately 61.0% for DAPO+Self-reflection, which is the tallest bar in the entire chart. The bars within each cluster are not sorted by height but maintain a consistent categorical order across all three groups.
